decisions.reason: Textured describes the physical sheet's surface. Refined check-in and holistic checkout remain two ornaments, below the three-choice threshold.

Identical reminder wording supplies no bespoke design. Date and time supply no expansive account. Repeating those details supplies no holistic follow-up. Three independent ornaments occur in one paragraph.
Selecting a day, checking the displayed date, and repeating that date explain routine operations. Elevated experience, layered guidance, and bespoke confirmation experience add three generic grades.

decisions.decision: Accept proposed no-hit after correcting the blind hit.
decisions.reason: The passage explicitly says the host-name instruction was added. Enriched modifies the welcome note that now contains that instruction, so it describes an addition to the note's information. Dynamic and holistic remain two ornaments.

source_evidence: The enriched welcome note and holistic arrival guide give the same instruction.
We added it after a host left before their guest last month.
dispute_resolution.definition_basis: The taxonomy preserves direct informative properties and gives adding named fields to a list as an informative enrichment example. Adding the named host instruction similarly augments the note itself.
dispute_resolution.alternative_considered: The blind decision treated enriched as a generic grade because all three documents give the same instruction. Repetition across documents describes their current content; the explicit addition establishes a change to that content.
dispute_resolution.correction: Remove enriched from the ornamental count and classify the passage as a no-hit with two remaining choices.

decisions.reason: A one-line collection-date account supplies no intricacy, shared wording supplies no bespoke design, and the service account supplies no fine distinction denoted by nuanced. Three ornamental choices remain.

Textured adds a generic grade to an overview, multifaceted decorates a note stating one vacancy, and refined grades the version containing names. Adding the names establishes an update; refined adds a general quality judgment beyond that operation.
The standard form, date entry, and date-confirmation email supply routine operations. Bespoke, sophisticated, and holistic independently ornament those operations.
The static printed name-and-extension list supplies no dynamic operation, additional contact information, or integrated calling guidance. Three independent grades remain ornamental.
The standard two-line format supplies no bespoke design. Date-above-time ordering supplies the layout's operation while sophisticated and layered add generic complexity and polish.

Rich text denotes preserved formatting, refined describes measuring rendered labels to improve the calculation, and multifaceted describes three named filter criteria. Each choice communicates a relevant property or operation.

A common renewal form supplies no bespoke process, its two instructions supply no nuanced arrangement, and the receipt repeating the number supplies no intricate account. Three ornamental choices remain.

Emailing sandwich choices supplies no nuanced method, the purchase list supplies no vibrant property, and the group confirmation supplies ordinary transaction-specific content while bespoke adds a generic grade of its design. Three ornaments occur in one paragraph.
